blogs.title: The Ultimate Pokhara Trade Mall Experience: Shopping, Dining & Cinema Guide
blogs.content:
Nestled in the bustling hub of Chiple Dhunga, Pokhara Trade Mall stands as the city's quintessential lifestyle hub. Whether you are a local resident catching up with friends or a traveler exploring Pokhara, here is your definitive insider walkthrough to maximizing your day.

1. Morning Coffee & Retail Therapy

Kick off your morning on the Ground Floor with artisanal espresso and fresh bakery treats. As the stores open, wander through the fashion wing housing premier apparel, Nepali pashmina scarves, high-grade trekking essentials, and footwear collections.

2. Authentic Himalayan Flavors at the Food Court

By midday, take the escalators up to the 4th Floor Food Court. From sizzling Thakali sets with organic Jimbu ghee to aromatic authentic momos and Continental burgers, the dining terrace offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Pokhara valley.

3. 4K Cinema & Entertainment

Cap off your afternoon at QFX Cinemas featuring state-of-the-art 4K laser projection and Dolby Atmos sound, or unleash your gaming spirit at the 4D VR Game Zone with thrilling arcade simulators.

blogs.title: Autumn Style Edit 2026: Must-Have Outfits & Trends at PTM Boutiques
blogs.content:
As the cool autumn breeze sweeps down from the Himalayas, it's time to refresh your wardrobe with seasonal warmth and timeless chic elegance.

Earthy Tones & Layered Textures

This season is all about rich olive greens, warm rust, soft camel coats, and tactile corduroy. Our retail partners across Level 1 and 2 have curated lightweight trench coats and knitted sweaters perfect for Pokhara evenings.

Fusion Festive Wear

With major celebrations on the horizon, explore contemporary fusion sarees, lightweight embroidered kurtas, and handcrafted jewelry sets that strike the perfect balance between heritage and modernity.

blogs.title: Foodie Guide: Top 6 Must-Try Delicacies at Pokhara Trade Mall Food Court
blogs.content:
Food lovers, rejoice! The revamped 4th Floor Food Court at Pokhara Trade Mall brings together beloved street favorites and artisanal gourmet creations under one roof.

1. The Royal Thakali Set

Served in shining traditional brass plates, enjoy aromatic local black dal, gundruk sandeko, tender mutton curry, and homemade Mustang radish pickles.

2. Jhol Momo Platters

Steaming hot chicken and buff momos bathed in a tangy, spicy sesame-peanut broth that will warm your soul.

3. Stone-Oven Thin Crust Pizza

Fresh mozzarella, local herbs, and hand-stretched sourdough crust baked to crisp perfection with artisanal chili olive oil drizzle.

blogs.title: QFX Cinemas Experience: Why Screen 2 4K Laser Projection is a Game Changer
blogs.content:
Moviegoing in Pokhara has reached new heights. QFX Cineplex at Pokhara Trade Mall has introduced state-of-the-art 4K RGB Laser Projection paired with Dolby Atmos 3D audio.

Pristine Visuals & Contrast

Witness deep, inky blacks and hyper-vibrant color gamuts that make every cinematic sequence breathtakingly lifelike.

Immersive 64-Channel Sound

With overhead acoustic speakers and subwoofers placed meticulously across the auditorium, feel every explosion and whisper right around you.

blogs.title: Self-Care Saturday: Holistic Spa, Grooming & Wellness at Pokhara Trade Mall
blogs.content:
Take time off your busy work schedule and treat yourself to a revitalizing day of grooming and holistic wellness on our Dedicated Services floor.

From aromatherapy massages using organic Himalayan herbs to modern styling and manicures, discover the tranquil side of Pokhara Trade Mall.

pages.title: Pokhara Trade Mall
pages.content:
Pokhara Trade Mall is the premier destination for shopping, dining, and leisure in the heart of Chiple Dhunga. We blend vibrant local culture with contemporary retail, featuring top fashion boutiques, electronics, and local artisan crafts.

Whether catching blockbusters at QFX Cineplex or enjoying gourmet meals at our food court, experience Pokhara's favorite social hub.

pages.title: About Pokhara Trade Mall
pages.content:
Welcome to Pokhara Trade Mall

The premier destination for shopping, entertainment, and leisure in the heart of Pokhara. As one of the city's first modern malls, we blend the vibrant local culture with a contemporary retail experience, offering everything from fashion boutiques and electronics to unique local handicrafts.

Whether you are looking to catch the latest blockbuster at our state-of-the-art QFX Cineplex, enjoy a delicious meal at our diverse food court, or explore a wide array of shops, Pokhara Trade Mall serves as the perfect social hub for families, tourists, and locals alike. Visit us today at Chiple Dhunga to experience the best of convenience, comfort, and community spirit in the beautiful lakeside city of Pokhara.

pages.title: Business & Leasing Directory
pages.content:
Leasing & Retail Opportunities

Pokhara Trade Mall is the premier commercial hub in Pokhara, receiving thousands of daily visitors from around the globe and local communities.

We offer prime retail, dining, and service counter space with high footfall, modern security, back-up power, and dedicated parking spaces.

To inquire about leasing space or partnership opportunities, contact our management team at leasing@pokharatrademall.com or call +977 61-520000.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
Privacy Policy

At Pokhara Trade Mall, we value your privacy. We strictly handle your personal information, inquiries, and booking details in accordance with applicable laws in Nepal.

We do not sell or share personal data with third-party marketers. For inquiries regarding our terms or data usage, please reach out to info@pokharatrademall.com.
